title: Agentic AI Control Planes: Independent Coverage-Verification and Reproducibility Package (PRISMA-ScR)
description: Independent coverage-verification and reproducibility artifact for the survey Agentic AI Control Planes: A Systematic Survey of Protocols, Security, Cloud-Native LLMOps, and Governance (Nageshwaran & Ezekiel, IEEE Open Journal of the Computer Society, 2026). The survey's reported search is an IEEE-Xplore-primary structured review with supplementary ACM searches and snowballing; this package independently re-harvests the same thirteen cluster queries through OpenAlex (an open, cross-publisher index) with the ACM Digital Library run as a second record-level database, then dual-screens the result, to test whether the cited corpus is recoverable from an independent path. Reported per PRISMA-ScR as a reproducible coverage check, not a claim of exhaustive completeness. Contents: frozen queries and protocol, harvest and deduplication code, the identified corpus and ranked queue, the ACM second-database search and its screening, dual-rater workbooks with reconciliations and Cohen's kappa, and the PRISMA-ScR flow, checklist, methods and limitations. Key results: 17,682 unique identified; an independent re-harvest re-identified 75 of the 119 cited research references (67% of those in-window); dual-screened mapping sample of 898 studies; ACM second-database overlap 90% (28 net-new, 3 included); inter-rater kappa 0.45 / 0.63 / 1.00 by tier.
